parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required when using Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey Secret or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description:
Whether to list archived projects.  
Valid values: true / false

parameters.name: minAccessLevel
parameters.description:
Least privilege filter. Enumeration values:  
- 20: Viewer  
- 30: Developer  
- 40: Administrator

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
Sorting field  
Valid values: created_at, id, name, path, updated_at, last_activity_at

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
Page number  
Default value is 1, starting from page 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description:
Page size  
Default value is 20. Valid range: [1, 100]

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sorting order  
Default value is desc.  
desc – descending  
asc – ascending
